title: Vague convergence gives convergence of ball measures at μ-null spheres (Simon 7.3.1 proof, display (4))
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μ (ball 0 r) ≠ ∞) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, μs j (ball 0 r) ≠ ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ y, f y ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, f y ∂μ))) → μ (sphere 0 ρ) = 0 → Tendsto (fun j => μs j (ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 (μ (ball 0 ρ)))
